name: Clavicle Fracture
definition: Fracture of the clavicle, most commonly the middle third, usually after direct shoulder impact or fall.

investigations.MRI: CT for complex medial fractures or associated injury.

green: Sling for comfort in suitable fractures
Early elbow/hand movement and progressive shoulder rehabilitation
amber: Surgery is considered for selected markedly displaced, open, neurovascular or nonunion-risk patterns.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna principles may complement rehabilitation after modern stability assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the clavicle, most commonly the middle third, usually after direct shoulder impact or fall.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
